support_claim: Although commercial notes assert that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, an unresolved_preservation proposition preserves differing name forms tied to the contract versus billing referents, so the identity judgment cannot be closed.

propositions.proposition: Billing records show billed_name Helion Robotics Limited.
propositions.relevance: Grounds what name is associated with the left referent billing:Helion Robotics Limited.

propositions.proposition: The master services agreement document names Helion Robotics Ltd. as the counterparty.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the counterparty name associated with the contract document linked to the right referent contract:MSA-HELION-2019.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM and that invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited.
propositions.relevance: Links the Ltd form on the contract to the Limited form on billing records for the candidate relation.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes explicitly state that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity.
propositions.relevance: Provides explicit same-entity evidence between the Ltd name on the contract and the Limited name on billing invoices.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes describe Helion Robotics Ltd as the CRM operating name and Helion Robotics Limited as the name used on invoices and Companies House, presenting two name forms across operational contexts.
propositions.relevance: Preserves differing name forms tied to contract versus billing contexts for the candidate referents unless identity is separately established.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from Helion Robotics.
propositions.relevance: Establishes distinctness of a similarly named Helion entity, relevant to ruling out confusion with the candidate referents.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd sold sensors in 2018 and has no current MSA.
propositions.relevance: Further distinguishes Helion Industrial Systems Ltd from the Helion Robotics entity tied to billing and the MSA-HELION-2019 contract.

propositions.proposition: The MSA-HELION-2019 contract effective date is 12 March 2019 with a 36-month initial term.
propositions.relevance: Provides contractual context for the right referent contract:MSA-HELION-2019 without directly asserting identity with the billing referent.
